children: China's housing sentiment likely improved in August, according to BofA Securities in a research note. A BofA survey showed that 40% of respondents expect prices to rise in Tier 1 cities. "The latest Tier 1 recovery appears more genuine, accompanied by inventory drawdown and a recovery in rental yields," they note. That said, sentiment remains weak in Tier 2 cities and the improvement elsewhere has been volatile, the bank says. Investors are watching for more clues on whether a durable recovery is taking hold across the broader housing market, BofA says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
